The RAPID vehicle fleet was comprised automated/autonomous five-passenger minivans equipped with an ADS designed and installed by May Mobility. One of the Toyota Sienna Autono-MaaS minivans used for the fleet was modified to provide a wheelchair ramp for ADA- suitable access. The RAPID service area was embedded within the larger operational area of the Arlington On-Demand service operating with conventional minivans and drivers. The large Arlington On-Demand system is a shared-ride microtransit service that operates throughout the entire city of Arlington (approximately 100 square miles) as its primary public transit service serving the city of approximately 400,000 residents with a fleet of roughly 65 vehicles, 4 of which make up the AV RAPID program. All vehicles in the RAPID fleet were hybrid electric, and approximately two-thirds of the larger Arlington On-Demand vehicle fleet are also hybrid electric vehicles. Arlington’s use of hybrid vehicles does not require any battery charging infrastructure for vehicle propulsion purposes. Via provided the customer interface and vehicle dispatching for both the conventional Arlington On-Demand and the automated RAPID AV fleets. The consolidated operation facilitates the gradual deployment of the AV service to larger portions of the existing Arlington On-Demand shared-ride transit service. All AV service in the Arlington RAPID system was attended. Although much of the driving is automated, the attendants are available to assume driving responsibilities if/when the vehicle automation cannot navigate the complexity of the environment as well as to host and interact with passengers. Fully automated (without an attendant) shared-ride on-demand AV microtransit lags in deployment compared to dedicated, single-party rides using the TNC business model for AV operations, based on known AV deployments. This is significant because the driver or attendant traditionally serves as an authoritative presence for multiparty service. Near the end of the RAPID deployment in spring 2025, May Mobility announced a partnership with Uber, which will offer May Mobility AVs on the Uber platform, starting in Arlington in late 2025.
